parsed.rationale: The cluster row carries no member records, no structural evidence (all fields — differing_slots, jaccard, shared_ancestor, shared_field_count — are null), and no field or method lists for either Discogs.ArtistImage or Discogs.SearchResult.CodingKeys. Without any grounded evidence of a meaningful subset relationship between these two types in Shared/Artwork/Sources/Artwork/DiscogsArtworkService.swift, no refactoring action can be justified.
